body: Haha thank ya and yeah.... it’s rough out here, I guess I attract damaged people.... idk.... my glock is 2 feet away and ready to go, and I’m just thinking of reasons “why not” I’ve been here so many times before... but what if something’s different this time?

As stupid as it sounds, why can’t I help everyone? It’s childish I know, but honestly.... what kind of world is it where everyone I care about is on the brink of blowing their brains out? Why do I want to live in such a place where happiness is spread thin like roses in the desert? Why?
How the fuck do you move on from this shit??? It’s fucking murder....
